Name: Loss of Trust
Description: The degradation or destruction of public/institutional confidence in the integrity, reliability, or legitimacy of a target actor.

Name: Infrastructure Failure
Description: The physical or functional breakdown of critical infrastructure systems, rendering them incapable of performing their intended service.

Name: Economic Loss
Description: Direct or indirect financial damage, market devaluation, or resource loss suffered by the target entity.

Name: Political Instability
Description: A condition where governance is challenged, weakened, or rendered ineffective due to internal conflict, protests, or institutional decay.

Name: Social Polarization
Description: The intensification of societal divisions, increasing internal conflict and reducing the capacity for collective action or consensus.

Name: Information Leakage
Description: The unauthorized exposure of sensitive, classified, or private information, resulting in loss of confidentiality or competitive advantage.

Name: Service Disruption
Description: Temporary or permanent interference with the continuity of digital or physical services provided by the target.

Name: Capability Degradation
Description: The long-term erosion of a target's ability to develop, maintain, or utilize specific military, technological, or political capabilities.

Name: Public Fear
Description: The induction of widespread anxiety, terror, or panic within a population to alter social behavior or force government compliance.

Name: Dependency Increase
Description: The strategic creation or exploitation of reliance on the initiating actor for economic, technological, or security needs.
